findings.summary: budgets_used.repairs is an event-adjacency heuristic presented as an exact count; it undercounts answer re-verification repairs and AUTH_REQUIRED endings and overcounts STALE then budget.exhausted (PR-24).
reconciliation.completed with found UNKNOWN marks the reconcile stage SUCCEEDED and drops the reconciliation wait while the run stays NEEDS_RECONCILIATION.
open_findings.message carries no model prose; pyshacl-generated sh:resultMessage can embed a proposed argument value, which matters when 3d.2 renders the ledger into model context.
ADR 0031 mentions plan items in the ledger but its field list and Stage have no plan link; 3d.2 may need it.
